answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 97 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 18 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 97 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 607 sponsors, each risking real money. The haven test is the live device, the willow test is the locked stake, and the mesa test is the graded history no template can fake.
